headline: Razorpay vs PayU vs Cashfree
description: Razorpay, PayU or Cashfree for your WooCommerce store? 2026 fees, plugin status, UPI and settlement speed compared — with a live fee calculator.

itemListElement.name: Razorpay vs PayU vs Cashfree: Best WooCommerce Payment Gateway for India (2026)

mainEntity.name: Which payment gateway is cheapest for WooCommerce in India?

acceptedAnswer.text: On standard published rates, Cashfree (1.95%) edges out Razorpay (~2%), while PayU adds a ₹4,999/year AMC on top of transaction fees. At typical small-store volumes the rate difference is small — success rates and settlement speed usually matter more.
Yes — Razorpay maintains an official WooCommerce plugin, making integration a configuration task. It's the smoothest setup of the three for most stores.

mainEntity.name: Can I use PayU with WooCommerce in 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: PayU's WordPress.org plugin was withdrawn in June 2026, so there's currently no supported official plugin — integrating it means custom development. Choose it only if you specifically need its international/EMI strengths.

mainEntity.name: Do these gateways support UPI AutoPay for subscriptions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Razorpay and Cashfree both support UPI AutoPay for recurring payments — relevant if your store sells subscriptions or memberships.
